title: NEW MD‑11 Adventures & Real Airline Flights Added! | MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update (PC)
description:
In the Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update for April 17, 2026, this week brings a fresh set of new activities for PC pilots  including the must‑have Adventure MD‑11 mission pack that’s perfect for long‑haul simmers looking to put this iconic tri‑jet through its paces! 😄

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 8LEGS GRAND TOUR – OCEANIA (Multi‑leg touring mission pack across Oceania)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Adventure MD‑11 (Long‑haul focused MD‑11 missions)
🗺️ Simple Missions: Delta Flights (Real‑world airline inspired flight missions)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Scheduled ARG [Winter 2025] (Realistic airline route schedules)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Scheduled EFW [Winter 2025] (Real-world timetable simulation)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Scheduled HVN [Winter 2025] (Winter seasonal operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Scheduled SAS [Winter 2025] (European airline scheduling)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Scheduled VIV [Winter 2025] (Regional airline operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – DGAA [Winter 2025] (Accra traffic schedules)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – ESSA [Winter 2025] (Stockholm airline ops)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – KBOS [Winter 2025] (Boston Logan schedules)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – RPLL [Winter 2025] (Manila intl operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – SUMU [Winter 2025] (Montevideo schedules)
